name: autocad-local-bridge
description: Safely draw basic lines and rectangles in the active local AutoCAD 2027 drawing.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to an AutoCAD 2027 plug-in running on the same Windows computer. The initial version supports connection status, lines, and rectangles only.

tools.name: autocad_status
tools.description: Check whether the local AutoCAD bridge is running and identify the active drawing.

tools.name: draw_line
tools.description: Draw one line in the active AutoCAD drawing after the user approves the tool call.

tools.name: draw_rectangle
tools.description: Draw one axis-aligned rectangle in the active AutoCAD drawing after the user approves the tool call.
